SELECT SEQ_NOTICE.NEXTVAL FROM dual
INSERT INTO notice (notice_id, notice_type, workspace_id, member_id, title, content, status) VALUES(#{noticeId}, 'WORKSPACE', #{workspaceId}, #{memberId}, #{title}, #{content}, 1)

INSERT INTO notice_files ( notice_file_id, notice_id, original_name, stored_name, file_path, file_size, uploaded ) VALUES (SEQ_NOTICE_FILES.NEXTVAL, #{noticeId}, #{originalName}, #{storedName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, SYSDATE)
mapper.select: SELECT nf.notice_id AS "noticeId", nf.notice_file_id AS "noticeFileId", nf.original_name AS "originalName", nf.stored_name AS "storedName", nf.file_path AS "filePath", nf.file_size AS "fileSize" FROM notice_files nf JOIN notice n ON n.notice_id = nf.notice_id WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.status = 1 AND n.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY nf.notice_file_id

SELECT nf.notice_id AS "noticeId", nf.notice_file_id AS "noticeFileId", nf.original_name AS "originalName", nf.stored_name AS "storedName", nf.file_path AS "filePath", nf.file_size AS "fileSize" FROM notice_files nf JOIN notice n ON n.notice_id = nf.notice_id WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND nf.notice_file_id = #{noticeFileId} AND n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.status = 1 AND n.deleted IS NULL

SELECT n.notice_id AS "noticeId", n.title, md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(n.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt", n.view_count AS "viewCount" FROM notice n LEFT OUTER JOIN member_details md ON n.member_id = md.member_id WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.status = 1 AND n.deleted IS NULL ORDER BY n.created DESC, n.notice_id DESC

SELECT n.notice_id AS "noticeId", n.title, n.content, md.name AS "authorName", TO_CHAR(n.created, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS "createdAt", n.view_count AS "viewCount" FROM notice n LEFT OUTER JOIN member_details md ON n.member_id = md.member_id WHERE n.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND n.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.status = 1 AND n.deleted IS NULL

SELECT n.notice_id AS "noticeId", n.title FROM notice n JOIN notice c ON c.workspace_id = n.workspace_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND c.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted IS NULL AND n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.status = 1 AND n.deleted IS NULL AND ( n.created > c.created OR ( n.created = c.created AND n.notice_id > c.notice_id ) ) ORDER BY n.created ASC, n.notice_id ASC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT n.notice_id AS "noticeId", n.title FROM notice n JOIN notice c ON c.workspace_id = n.workspace_id WHERE c.workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND c.notice_id = #{noticeId} AND c.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND c.status = 1 AND c.deleted IS NULL AND n.notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND n.status = 1 AND n.deleted IS NULL AND ( n.created < c.created OR ( n.created = c.created AND n.notice_id < c.notice_id ) ) ORDER BY n.created DESC, n.notice_id DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY
mapper.update: UPDATE notice SET title = #{title}, content = #{content}, updated = SYSDATE WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND status = 1 AND deleted IS NULL
UPDATE notice SET deleted = SYSDATE, updated = SYSDATE WHERE notice_id = #{noticeId} AND workspace_id = #{workspaceId} AND notice_type = 'WORKSPACE' AND status = 1 AND deleted IS NULL
